newsitem.title: GREECE: No Athibor on Tues as most Greek banks abstain.
newsitem.headline: No Athibor on Tues as most Greek banks abstain.

text.p: Greek Athibor rates will not be available on Tuesday as most Greek banks refused to quote rates following confusion and uncertainty over reports of a government plan to tax interbank depos.

State-owned National Bank of Greece, Commercial Bank of Greece, Ionian bank and private Alpha Credit Bank and Ergo Bank were the only banks quoting rates for one-month funds. No bank quoted rates for longer periods.
A minimum of nine banks must quote prices for the system to calculate averages.

Bankers expressed concern that policy makers were tampering with local markets that they did not seem to fully understand, which was leading to tax initiatives that could cause harm. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
